info.name: User Management System API
info.description:
REST endpoints for the User Management System. Start the app first (default http://localhost:8080).

LOGIN: every request needs a logged-in session. Run folder 0 first: it logs in as the admin (adminEmail / adminPassword variables). Postman keeps the session cookie for you. The collection-level scripts also copy the security (CSRF) token from the XSRF-TOKEN cookie into the X-XSRF-TOKEN header of every request, which Spring Security needs on POST / PUT / PATCH / DELETE.

Run the folders IN ORDER (Collection Runner or one by one). Folder 1 saves the role ids into collection variables, and the other folders use them.

0. Login: logs in as the admin.
1. Roles - read: lists roles and saves their ids.
2. Users - read: list, search, get one, errors.
3. Users - create, update, delete: uses its own test users and deletes them at the end. Checks status, createdAt and updatedAt.
4. Roles - status rules: error cases and GUEST protection. Changes no data.
5. Role deactivation flow: WARNING, this changes real data (see the folder description).
6. Permissions: what Admin, Manager and User may and may not do. Creates its own test users and deletes them. Ends logged in as the admin.

Every request has tests (see the Test Results tab).

Passwords: creating a user needs a password (6+ characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a special character). When editing, leave it out to keep the current one. The API never sends a password back, only "hasPassword": true/false.

item.name: 5. Role deactivation flow - CHANGES REAL DATA
item.description:
WARNING: this folder deactivates the MANAGER role. That moves ALL real MANAGER users to GUEST, and activating MANAGER again does NOT move them back. Only run it on test data, or move those users back by hand afterwards.

Steps: create a test user with MANAGER -> deactivate MANAGER -> the user is now GUEST -> MANAGER cannot be assigned -> activate MANAGER -> the user stays GUEST -> delete the test user.

item.name: Create flow user with MANAGER role (201)
Deactivate MANAGER - users move to GUEST (200)

item.name: 6. Permissions - Admin, Manager, User
item.description:
Checks who may do what. Starts logged in as the admin (folder 0), creates a test manager, a test user and an inactive test user, logs in as each of them, and deletes the test users at the end. Ends logged in as the admin again.

Admin: everything, but cannot delete themselves or change their own role / status.
Manager: list users, delete users (not Admins, not themselves). Nothing else.
User / Guest: only their own details (/api/me).

exec: pm.test('Message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('You cannot delete your own account'));
